messages.supplier.favorit.setting.name: Favorit supplier settings
messages.supplier.favorit.setting.description: Controls connection settings for the Favorit supplier integration.
messages.supplier.favorit.setting.is.enabled.name: Integration enabled
messages.supplier.favorit.setting.is.enabled.desc: Enables or disables the Favorit supplier integration.
messages.supplier.favorit.setting.base.url.name: Base URL
messages.supplier.favorit.setting.base.url.descri: Base URL used to send requests to the Favorit supplier API.
messages.supplier.favorit.setting.api.key.name: API key
messages.supplier.favorit.setting.api.key.descrip: API key used to authorize requests to the Favorit supplier API.
messages.supplier.favorit.setting.has.api.key.des: Shows whether an API key is stored for the Favorit supplier integration.
messages.supplier.tmtr.setting.name: TMTR supplier settings
messages.supplier.tmtr.setting.description: Controls connection and delivery settings for the TMTR supplier integration.
messages.supplier.tmtr.setting.is.enabled.name: Integration enabled
messages.supplier.tmtr.setting.is.enabled.descrip: Enables or disables the TMTR supplier integration.
messages.supplier.tmtr.setting.base.url.name: Base URL
messages.supplier.tmtr.setting.base.url.descripti: Base URL used to send requests to the TMTR supplier API.
messages.supplier.tmtr.setting.delivery.offset.de: Number of days added to the guaranteed delivery date.
messages.supplier.tmtr.setting.login.name: Login
messages.supplier.tmtr.setting.login.description: Login used to authorize requests to the TMTR supplier API.
messages.supplier.tmtr.setting.password.name: Password
messages.supplier.tmtr.setting.password.descripti: Password used to authorize requests to the TMTR supplier API.
messages.supplier.tmtr.setting.has.password.name: Password configured
messages.supplier.tmtr.setting.has.password.descr: Shows whether a password is stored for the TMTR supplier integration.
messages.supplier.armtek.setting.name: Armtek supplier settings
messages.supplier.armtek.setting.description: Controls connection, account and storage binding settings for the Armtek supplier integration.
messages.supplier.armtek.setting.is.enabled.name: Integration enabled
messages.supplier.armtek.setting.is.enabled.descr: Enables or disables the Armtek supplier integration.
messages.supplier.armtek.setting.base.url.name: Base URL
messages.supplier.armtek.setting.base.url.descrip: Base URL used to send requests to the Armtek supplier API.
messages.supplier.armtek.setting.login.name: Login
messages.supplier.armtek.setting.login.descriptio: Login used for Basic authentication in the Armtek supplier API.
messages.supplier.armtek.setting.password.name: Password
messages.supplier.armtek.setting.password.descrip: Password used for Basic authentication in the Armtek supplier API.
messages.supplier.armtek.setting.has.password.des: Shows whether a password is stored for the Armtek supplier integration.
messages.supplier.armtek.setting.sales.organizati: Armtek sales organization code (VKORG), for example 4000.
messages.supplier.armtek.setting.customer.code.de: Armtek buyer code (KUNNR_RG) used in search requests.
messages.supplier.armtek.setting.contract.code.de: Armtek contract code (VBELN). If empty, the default contract is used.
messages.supplier.armtek.setting.storages.name: Storage bindings
messages.supplier.armtek.setting.storages.descrip: Binds our storages to Armtek pickup points or delivery addresses. Armtek is not requested for storages without a binding.
messages.supplier.armtek.setting.storage.code.des: Our storage for which Armtek offers are requested.
messages.supplier.armtek.setting.delivery.mode.de: Pickup from an Armtek point or delivery to an address (INCOTERMS).
messages.supplier.armtek.setting.point.code.name: Point code
messages.supplier.armtek.setting.point.code.descr: Armtek pickup point ID or delivery address code (KUNNR_ZA).
